_comment: Per-target limits for arm64-generic (Radxa, Orange Pi, Khadas, Le Potato, ...). Best-effort target — per-board quirks are inherited at runtime, not baked in. Copied to /etc/deputyos/limits.json at bake time. Schema in deputyctl/src/limits.rs. See docs/14-limitations.md §'arm64-generic'.

limitations.reason: arm64-generic covers a long tail of SBCs we don't individually test; per-board quirks (device-tree overlay, audio routing, video output, thermal envelope) are the user's responsibility
limitations.unblock: switch to rpi5 (officially supported) or x86_64-mini-pc

limitations.reason: Device-tree overlay, audio routing, and video output depend on the specific board; the wizard collects the overlay name on first boot
limitations.unblock: provide your board's overlay name during the first-boot wizard

limitations.reason: Hailo / Coral / OpenVINO not bundled — too fragmented across boards to ship by default
limitations.unblock: sideload the runtime your board supports (see docs/12-bundled-software.md)

limitations.reason: Generic arm64 default RAM (4 GB) below local-LLM threshold; even at 8GB, A-core class is unverified per board
Voice and audio features depend on board-specific audio routing; disabled until the user supplies a working device-tree overlay
limitations.unblock: supply the correct overlay during the first-boot wizard

limitations.reason: Vendor firmware (Mali GPU, board-specific WiFi) not installed at bake time; mainline arm64 kernel only
limitations.unblock: install vendor firmware packages manually after first boot

limitations.reason: WhatsApp Cloud webhook RSS exceeds standard tier headroom
